_comment: TBC Classic raid boss creature types, for creature-type-gated consumable grading. Elixir of Demonslaying (+265 AP) only helps vs Demon; Consecrated Sharpening Stone (+to-hit/dmg) only helps vs Undead. Matched by lowercased boss name substring. Wings group bosses into comfortable 4-6-boss matrix tables. Sources: tbc.wowhead.com, warcraft.wiki.gg (researched 2026-06).

_notes.leotheras the blind: Humanoid — his demon FORM is cosmetic; only the Inner Demon adds are Demon-type. Demonslaying on Leo's body is wasted.
_notes.high astromancer solarian: Humanoid — transforms to a void form in P3 but the targetable mob stays Humanoid; demonslaying unreliable, treat as wasted.
